summary: Removes a buggy short-circuit that returned the input unchanged when it was already in NFKD form, so accents are now stripped from pre-normalized strings as the issue requires. Correct, minimal, no regression.

issues.description: Drops the early-return fast path for strings with no combining characters, so every input now allocates a new joined string via the list comprehension. Negligible cost and the old fast path was the source of the bug, so not worth retaining.
